invariants.rationale: If type is null, 'string', or 'file', the method returns value, so result equals value; otherwise, this constraint need not hold.
If type is 'int', method returns Integer.valueOf(value), so result must be Integer.
If type is 'float', method returns Float.valueOf(value), so result must be Float.
If type is 'bool', method returns Boolean.valueOf(value), so result must be Boolean.
If type is 'color', method returns Color.valueOf(...), so result must be a Color instance.
